builders.angle: LITERAL -- the angle that won rounds 20, 23-25 and 29. Work BRIEF-r33's fix list 1 to 4 in order and exactly as written: the small text to 11px FIRST on all four screens, then the one button, then the sliders and the piles rail, then the late run strip.

ONE CONTROL VOCABULARY. Design the house's control set once, as appended kit.css sections -- the enamel-disc-plus-cartouche button, the price-tag button, the engraved brass rail with its knob, the medallion toggle that cycles -- each drawn to the samples' ornament, then apply that one vocabulary to every control on the four screens and TAKE NONE, then fit the text to 11px around it.

THE DECK FIRST. The judges score these boards at 1280: work at 1280x800 first and measure -- every running line at 11px or more and readable contrast, the run strip's icons at 30px or more with the pouch overflow, each control big enough for a trackpad -- then restyle the controls into house objects within that layout, then check the default size.
